title: Food Advisor for the Broadland Food Innovation Centre - Broadland District Council - AWARD
description:
You are invited to tender for the provision to deliver Food Advisor Services for the Broadland Food Innovation Centre (BFIC) Project for Broadland District Council (BDC) Procurement Ref. 024-BD-23. 
      
      The Broadland Food Innovation Centre (https://foodinnovationbroadland.com) is an ERDF-funded project which supports food and drink businesses to innovate, connect to academia, and grow. The project involves contribution from Broadland District Council, University of East Anglia, Hethel Innovation, and the New Anglia Local Enterprise Partnership.
      
      Broadland District Council requires a Food Advisor to  provide support and advice to food and drink SMEs delivered through the Broadland Food Innovation Centre project. This will include working with the 'business tracking (CRM-database) system' to maintain full records including details of support, financial and accounting records and required administrative duties for the project.

title: Gypsy and Traveller and Travelling Show People Accommodation Needs in Breckland Distrct Council Local Authority Area Ref: 009-BK-23 - AWARD
description: Breckland District Council are seeking to appoint appropriately qualified consultants to undertake the GTAA for the area.  This work is expected to respond to the latest national policy and guidance and consider the needs for all groups that identify as Gypsy, Travellers or Travelling Showpeople.  In this regard it is expected that the GTAA will be informed by the national definition of Gypsy and Travellers, and additionally consider and provide advice on the needs arising in accordance with the decision of the Court of Appeal in the case of Lisa Smith and Secretary of State for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities, June 2022.  The GTAA will be focused upon needs within Breckland District Council's administrative boundary.  However, the study will be expected to adequately reflect an understanding of any cross-border issues impacting needs and provision across Norfolk and Suffolk.  Direct relationships with the immediately adjacent authorities of Mid Suffolk, West Suffolk, King's Lynn and West Norfolk, North Norfolk and Broadland should be considered.
